output.summary: The cadence slip tracks the single-reviewer security gate, not engineer discipline. Squad-controlled stages are unchanged, and PR, commit and story-point output is flat. Non-gated Reporting patch releases kept a 14-day cadence. The August delegate natural experiment cleared the queue, produced six releases, and the backlog returned once the delegate left. 88% of idle tickets await security review. Tech debt and CI metrics are essentially flat. Reviewer per-review time is stable. Morale fell, but it is confounded by the salary freeze and by waiting on review. Raise review capacity now. Do not suspend the gate or launch the accountability program. Scope tiering needs review-outcome data first.
